Episode 174. Veil's Misconception (1)
As the power of the Graveyard Giants was injected, the core of the seal emitted an even stronger light.

The light soaring into the sky looked like a pillar that could be the center of all the seas in the world. Those who had been suffering from the red rays thought this was a form of attack, but the light pouring out from the seal was merely beautiful.
The light was coloring everything from the seabed drilled in a cylindrical shape, to the sea's aura, seawater, and the sky stained from battle.
The attack of the Graveyard Giants stopped, and as the chaotic scene was momentarily purified, the people felt momentarily devout.
Jin kept his focus on the core without relaxing his tension.
Jin's face gradually became shocked as he watched.
"…Valeria."
"Yeah, I'm feeling it too."
The energy of the Graveyard Giants connected to the core was being amplified endlessly, as if plants that had been holding in the light for a long time were standing up.
The two naturally expected all the power of the Graveyard Giants to be consumed in opening the seal, but it was rather the opposite.
Even if the Graveyard Giants become stronger, if they have no ego, they're just more solid weapons from Jin's perspective.
But Jin felt like there was more to it.
The Graveyard Giants were kneeling down, laying down their spears and shields, as if they were believers performing a religious ritual.
It wasn't an action that an egoless weapon would do.
Soon, as the light spreading around was instantly converged, the seal began to open. As the seal slowly broke, Valeria was opening the record window.
<Jin Runecandle, Valeria Hister, and 156 Graveyard Giants unseal the old Runecandle…>
<…Unsealing the seal of Veil Runecandle, the ten knights of the old Runecandle.>
Veil.
The owner of the sword Hedog had, and a character presumed to be a figure from the old Runecandle. He was waking up from a thousand-year sleep, receiving the reverence of the Graveyard Giants.
"Veil Runecandle……"
Without needing to check the record window further, Jin and Valeria immediately recognized that he was the 'Forgotten God.'
A figure who was both the Forgotten God and a member of the old Runecandle.

He had a similar physique to Jin and had a human-like shape. However, a subtle golden light flowed all over his body, his eyes were in the shape of a cross, and runic characters and seams were visible all over his body.
He had two large, white wings on his back, and a shining ring floated above his head. His shape was almost similar to the typical depiction of an angel in religious mythology.
Before long, the sword that had been stuck in the seabed was in his hand. The ten small blades sprouting on both sides of the blade revealed that this was the original owner and shape of the sword.
"The last-born of the Runecandles, Jin Runecandle, greets his ancestor."
Jin said, following etiquette.
"I've never heard of a non-human among the ten great knights. This is because even the dragons could not remember him due to the manipulated history.
However, from the moment Veil woke up, Quicantel, who was in the air, felt her memories of him returning rapidly.
'Veil…! The offspring of the sun!'
A thousand years ago when Quicantel first met Veil, he introduced himself in this way. Although he did not explain what 'offspring of the sun' meant, he was a unique being in many ways.
Veil was the only one who swore loyalty to an individual, not a member of Runcandel, even after becoming one of the ten great knights.
"Lord Quicantel, it seems like our lord has awakened the old Runcandel. That shining being is…."
[I remember now, damn it. If I knew that it was Veil, I would not have opened this tomb. Moreover, that state is the complete lifting of the prohibition.]
"What do you mean?"
[Sara is... gone. I need to go down and tell Jin about Veil first… Damn!]
As a flustered Quicantel rambled on, his colleagues were engulfed by anxiety.
Suddenly, hundreds of golden magic circles were formed in the entire sky.
The magic circles were aiming at all forces and seemed to be about to fire something, which was more akin to divine power than magic.
Everyone, stop moving.
Veil's faint voice spread.
Quicantel clenched his teeth and stopped descending, but the rest of the forces, who did not know Veil well, defied his words.
Chiiiing-!
Golden rays poured out of the magic circle at those who moved. Veil's rays showed monstrous power, tearing apart the battleships and dragons of the three forces like paper.
'...Is that the former owner of my sword?'
Hedo was also on high alert. Without even confronting the sword, he wondered if he could truly protect Sandra from that author. Moreover, he was now without a sword.
A magic circle also formed behind Jin and Valeria.
[Jin Runcandel?]
Jin turned his head and examined the magic circle behind his back.
"Yes, Sir Veil Runcandel."
[Where is Sara?]
"A thousand years have passed while you were sealed."
[I asked where Sara is.]
"Do you really not know?"
[Sara! If she's dead, I'll destroy the whole world!]
At the unexpected conversation, Jin had goosebumps.
This was because he instinctively knew that Veil's insane words were not nonsense.
["No, Sara couldn't have died... I've said something strange. Guide me, Jin Luncandel. I have to meet her."]
"Your Grace, you are neither tainted by chaos nor dead like the other ten knights, and your memory is also intact, am I right?"
[Why are you talking nonsense when I said let's go see Sara?]
"Sara passed away in the era when you were active, a thousand years ago."
[Shut up! Redhead woman, you guide me. I can't talk with this guy. Say Sara is dead one more time, I will twist your head off. You're lucky you have the name she loves, that's why I'm sparing you.]
Valeria locked eyes with Jin.
She, too, had no idea that the awakened being would be such a madman.
[Oh, looking at you, you resemble the housekeeper. Are you a descendant of Leot? If you don't know Sara's location either, guide me to where Leot is. He would know.]
The moment he said that, Jin remembered that he had met a living 'Leot', not the 'Leot in the records'.
-If I leave this place, will you be alone again, Leot? I will forget my memories about you...

-[You will only remember what you saw in the recording device. About me. But Jin, I am practically dead and forgotten anyway. Helping the living people outside is more valuable than comforting my loneliness.]
-...I will come back. Definitely.
He remembered the conversation he saw in the third tomb. The memories Veil had were powerful enough to undo the faint historical manipulation.
Just as Valeria was about to answer something, Jin spoke first.
"Alright, let's meet Leot first."
Jin had promised to help Valeria find her memory by meeting Leot, taking her out of that dark space.
With the help of Veil's power, he thought he could keep that promise.
[I don't want to talk to the guy who said Sara died. I asked Leot's descendant. Now, tell me. Redhead, where is Leot?]
"Grooo! Grooo!"
"Groo!"
The kneeling giants in the cemetery inserted their chirping, as if urging for an answer.
"Um... What if Leot doesn't know Sara's location?"
As soon as Valeria answered, life filled Veil's eyes.
[You're lying... I can smell the filthy scent unique to lying humans.]
"What lie?"
[You also think Sara is dead, don't you?]
In the end, Valeria let out a low sigh.
"Firstly, I never lied. The fact that Sara passed away is true, and you're making a fuss to us who woke you up after a thousand years. When did I ever say Sara is alive? That would be a lie."
[I won't talk to you either, Leot's descendant.]
Chiing-!
A golden beam was shot from the magic circle that opened behind the two. Jin quickly embraced Valeria to dodge the beam, and in the meantime, Veil was swinging his sword.
"Lord Veil, I was directly passed down the Eopwha from Lady Sarah. Do you really think Lady Sarah would be pleased with you attacking me?"
Jin, who had repelled Veil's attack with Sigmund, switched his sword and said. As Jin showed signs of bringing out the Eopwha with a blazing flame, Veil smirked.
"So it's even more impossible that Sarah is dead. How could a dead person pass her sword down to you? From the shape of the rune, it's definitely Sarah's sword."
They simply weren't communicating.
Sarah Runecandle had gone mad.
For some reason, Jin saw a streak of Hedow in him. It was a bit different, but blindly cherishing someone was essentially the same thing.
Hedow too, if Sandra were to die, would probably say he'd become a ghost of vengeance and destroy the whole world.
'He's not an opponent who can be subdued.'
A former Knight of Ten and a divine being who may possess power on his own level, or perhaps even greater.
Moreover, he had partially lifted the historical manipulation about Leot with just a few words, and held intact memories of the past.
"So you're also scheming to monopolize Sarah like Paddleur?"
"What are you talking about?"
"I know it all. I should kill that wicked man who feigned weakness and stole Sarah."
"Paddleur passed away a thousand years ago."
"Is that so? Then what's this aura of blue thunder that I'm starting to feel from afar? Liar."
When he heightened his senses, he really could feel Paddleur's aura. Just like in Calderan Tundra, it seemed he was being summoned again.
Jin wanted to reply that this wasn't the real Paddleur, but a being summoned by the prophet after corrupting his soul into chaos... but it was clear he wouldn't listen.
"Heh, I'll kill the bastard and get Sarah back......"
The moment Veil finished his sentence, Sandra, who had been unconscious, abruptly opened her eyes. As soon as she woke up and saw the underwater situation, she cried out.
"What's that monster, Mr. Jin is in danger!"
"Miss, miss?"
And then, without hesitating for even a second, she hurled herself forward. Swallowing a sigh, Hedow immediately followed Sandra and jumped off Quicantel's back.
"Mr. Jin, I'm coming to save you!"
"Miss, it's no use trying to save me. Once this is over, I'll definitely kill the 12th generation!"
"Sandra!?"
In the midst of the chaotic situation, Jin and Valeria watched as Veil stared blankly at the plummeting Sandra.
Veil was saying this.
"Sarah......!? Sarah, right. Here you are!"
He was talking to Sandra.
